peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 10% above its local comparables; 47 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (48.9): 3.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 43 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 87.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,087,500 ($1,301 psf, 807–914 sq ft; 8 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,117 psf (range $1,027–1,265); 16.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $154,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,510,000 ($1,156 psf, 1,291–1,550 sq ft; 10 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,118 psf (range $1,062–1,232); 3.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $50,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bukit Panjang LRT about 200 m, Bukit Panjang MRT about 350 m; closer than 75 of 94 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Bukit Panjang Primary School about 690 m; more than 62 of 94 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 430 m), more than 35 of 94 similar developments (the same as 12); nearest hawker centre Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre about 1,000 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 200 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Myst, 46 new sales, about 290 m; The Arden, 3 new sales, about 770 m; The Botany at Dairy Farm, 2 new sales, about 1,470 m; Narra Residences, 214 new sales, about 1,520 m; Hillhaven, 13 new sales, about 1,560 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 42 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 278 new sales and 502 resales (780 purchases); new sales were 35.6% of these purchases. Subsales (27) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dairy Farm Walk GLS site (Jan 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,320 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 502 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 54 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 502 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 564 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−11%). Planning-area private resales −27.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
